item.title: Could Stutzle's comments change how Tkachuk's Senators exit is seen?
item.summary: Tim Stutzle commented on the loss of Brady Tkachuk for the Ottawa Senators, saying the team has to worry about the team they have today and the team they hope to be in the future. The remarks were complimentary of Tkachuk as a teammate and player, but mentions of players wanting to stay in Ottawa fuelled speculation that the comments carried a subtle message. The NHL situation also underscores Ottawa’s changing leadership structure.
